# ARS

> ARS (AI Support & Web) builds custom AI customer service systems and websites for Australian small businesses — trades especially. Based in Brisbane, Australia.

ARS builds AI agents that answer calls and website enquiries, check calendar availability, and book jobs automatically for small businesses. It also builds custom business websites, including bundles that combine a website with an AI system. Every system is custom-built per business, not off-the-shelf software.

## Company
- [Home](https://www.arswebservices.com/): Overview of ARS and its AI customer service systems.
- [Services](https://www.arswebservices.com/services): What ARS builds — AI phone/chat answering, scheduling, and website design.
- [Pricing](https://www.arswebservices.com/pricing): AI system tiers (Starter, Growth, Complete) and website pricing.
- [Book a demo](https://www.arswebservices.com/book): Free live demo booking.
- [Contact](https://www.arswebservices.com/contact): Contact details and enquiry form.
